title: Why some QR codes stop working after a free trial
description: Understand static codes, dynamic redirects, and trial expiry. Check a code before printing and learn what you can do if an existing code stops working.

title: QR code stopped working? How to find the cause and fix it
description: Scan it and look at what opens. Find out if the print, your website, or the QR company's redirect failed, and which fixes need a reprint.

title: What happens to your QR codes when you cancel? What 11 QR companies say
description: Whether your printed codes keep working after a trial ends or you cancel depends on the company. Their own policies side by side, with sources.

title: Paid $1 for a QR code, then charged again? How QR trial subscriptions work
description: That $1 QR code was likely a 7-day trial that renews. How to cancel, ask for a refund, and what happens to the code you already printed.

title: Bitly QR code alternative: Scanstone vs Bitly, side by side
description: Bitly QR codes don't expire, but editing one starts at $120 a year with 5 changes a month. How Bitly and Scanstone compare on price, edits and cancelling.

title: Is qr-code-generator.com free? QR Code Generator vs Scanstone
description: Static codes are free. Dynamic codes get a 14-day trial, then switch off until you pay from $119.88 a year. Prices, cancelling, and a free alternative.

title: Uniqode alternative: Scanstone vs Uniqode (Beaconstac), side by side
description: Uniqode has no free editable codes: a 14-day trial, then plans from $108 a year with scan caps. How it compares with Scanstone on price, limits and cancelling.

title: Permanent QR code: how to make one that keeps working
description: A QR code pattern never expires. What stops it is the address inside. Three ways to make a permanent QR code for free, and what to check before you print.

title: Why people hate QR code menus, and how to fix yours
description: Slow on bad signal, cookie banners, logins, no paper option. The common QR menu complaints and a plain fix for each, plus a two-minute check before service.

title: Bitly QR code showing an ad? Why, and how to remove it
description: Bitly puts a preview page with an ad in front of free-plan links and QR codes. How to tell which kind you have, what removes it, and when you must reprint.
